raw:
Jab Apna Hi Ghar Sukoon Ke Bajaye Darr Ki Wajah Ban Jaye 💔 

6 November 2026 | Friday

Ek personal experience, kuch psychological realities, aur hamare muashray ke naam ek paigham.

🌧️ Aakhir Mere Saath Aisa Kyun Hota Hai? 

Kabhi kabhi main apni zindagi ke baare mein sochta hoon to ek ajeeb si baat mehsoos hoti hai.

Main jo chahta hoon, aksar woh ho nahi pata.

Jab bhi main kisi kaam mein aage barhne lagta hoon, jab mujhe lagta hai ke ab main apni manzil ke qareeb hoon, ab kuch achha hone wala hai, tabhi achanak koi na koi rukawat saamne aa jati hai.

Kabhi kabhi to aisa lagta hai jaise koi anjaani taqat hai jo mujhe aage barhne hi nahi dena chahti.

Lekin jab main apne bachpan se lekar aaj tak ki zindagi par nazar daalta hoon, to ek ajeeb ittefaq saamne aata hai.

Main bachpan se jo bhi karna chahta tha, aksar mere abu usi kaam se mujhe rokte thay ya daant dete thay.

Ab aisa bhi nahi ke mujhe daant se hi masla hai.

Aakhir maa-baap hain. Kabhi galti par daant bhi sakte hain, samjha bhi sakte hain, aur zaroorat par sakhti bhi kar sakte hain.

Lekin...

Gussa tab aata hai jab ek hi galti ke liye ghar mein do alag qanoon hon.

Aur shayad meri kahani ki asal shuruaat yahin se hoti hai.

⚖️ Ek Ghar, Do Bhai, Lekin Galtiyon Ke Alag Faislay 

Mera ek chhota bhai hai, jo mujhse taqreeban 2 se 4 saal chhota hoga.

Main aksar ek baat notice karta aaya hoon.

Jab woh koi galti karta hai to kabhi uski galti ignore kar di jati hai, kabhi usay positive tareeqay se samjha diya jata hai, aur kabhi uski galti ko ek chhota sa issue samajh kar khatam kar diya jata hai.

Lekin agar wahi galti main kar doon?

To bas phir samjho pahaad toot para! Zameen par zalzala aa gaya! 😑

Ek chhoti si baat itni bari ban jati hai ke mujhe samajh nahi aata ke aakhir maine aisa kya kar diya.

Aur sabse zyada takleef tab hoti hai jab sirf abu hi nahi, balki ami bhi mere bhai ki side leti hain.

Ab main yeh nahi keh raha ke mera bhai bura hai ya uski galtiyon par bhi usay meri tarah daanta jaye.

Bilkul nahi!

Main sirf itna chahta hoon ke jis tarah uski galtiyon ko samjha jata hai, meri galtiyon ko bhi usi tarah samjha jaye.

Kyunke mere nazdeek insaaf ka matlab yeh nahi ke sabko barabar saza mile.

Insaaf ka matlab yeh bhi hai ke sabko barabar samajhne ki koshish ki jaye.

🧠 Ek Psychological Reality 

Psychology mein siblings ke saath mukhtalif sulook ko differential parental treatment kaha jata hai.

Yani jab parents apne bachon ke saath mukhtalif tareeqon se pesh aate hain.

Har different treatment na-insafi nahi hota. Bachon ki umar, zaroorat, maturity aur circumstances alag ho sakte hain.

Lekin jab ek bachay ko baar baar yeh mehsoos hone lage ke uski galti hamesha bari aur doosre ki galti hamesha chhoti samjhi jati hai, to uske andar resentment, gussa aur emotional distance paida ho sakta hai.

Main apne experience ko dekhta hoon to mujhe kuch aisa hi mehsoos hota hai.

Aur ek aur baat...

Aise halaat mein kabhi kabhi gussa asal galti se zyada us galti par hone wale unequal reaction ki wajah se hota hai.

Shayad mere saath bhi kuch aisa hi hai.

🏠 Jab Apne Hi Ghar Mein Dil Na Lage 

Ab doosra masla...

Aur mere liye shayad yeh pehle se bhi zyada takleef-deh hai.

Jab bhi mere abu ghar aate hain, pata nahi mujhe kya ho jata hai.

Mera apne hi ghar aane ka dil nahi karta.

Qasam se!

Yeh baat likhte hue bhi mujhe ajeeb lag raha hai.

Kyunke ghar to woh jagah hoti hai jahan insaan duniya bhar ki pareshaniyan bhool kar sukoon mehsoos karta hai.

Lekin mere saath aksar ulta hota hai.

Jab abu ghar hote hain, main koshish karta hoon ke unse door rahoon.

Aksar doosre kamray mein chala jata hoon.

Kyun?

Kyunke mere zehan mein pehle se ek darr hota hai.

Agar main abu ke saath baith gaya to koi na koi baat meri hi shuru ho jayegi.

Chahe topic kuch bhi ho.

Chahe baat kisi aur ki chal rahi ho.

Chahe sab log araam se baithe hon.

Mujhe lagta hai ke kisi na kisi tarah baat meri kisi galti tak zaroor pohanch jayegi.

Aur meri observation ke mutabiq aksar hota bhi aisa hi hai.

Agar main taqreeban 10 minute se zyada abu ke saath ek kamray mein baith jaun to koi na koi baat shuru ho jati hai.

Tareef?

Woh to mujhe bohat kam sunne ko milti hai.

Lekin meri kisi galti ko pakar kar negative baatein karna, lecture dena aur daantna...
Baat koi bhi ho mujh sy abu kahy ga wo kaam kar lo ma kahon Acha tu agar usi waqt na kiya tu bas lecture shuru

Aur ab wo kaam bhi ma karon jo mujhy abu ny kaha hi ni jaisy  bike yahan kiyon khari ha yahan kiyon ni 
Bhai mujhu kiya pta yahan kiyo khari ha ma ny konsa chalai ha han agar ma chalao tab ma usko sahi tehrao abu khud bahir jaye ga wapis ay ga aur tehra dy ga phir mujh sy poochy ga yahan kiyon tehrii ha ma kahon ga ma ny konsa tehrai ha tu kahy ga ky tumhy nazar ni arhi ky ye yahan tehrii ha isy sahi tehra dety tumhari laparwahi barhtii ja rhi ha aur har waqt mobile aur laptop ny tumhara dimaag kharab kar diya ha aur responsible ni ho aur bas aisy hi muft ma lecture shuru hojata ha

Yeh sab mujhe baar baar experience hota hai.

Kabhi kabhi itna sunna parta hai ke mera sar dard karne lagta hai.

Saara mood kharab ho jata hai.

Aur us waqt dil karta hai ke bas ghar chhor kar kahin door chala jaun.

🧠 Jab Darr Waqia Hone Se Pehle Hi Shuru Ho Jaye 

Psychology mein ek concept hai jise anticipatory anxiety kaha jata hai.

Iska matlab yeh hai ke insaan kisi unpleasant experience ke hone se pehle hi uske baare mein pareshan hone lagta hai.

Misal ke taur par, agar kisi student ko har roz class mein kisi teacher ke saamne zaleel hone ka darr ho, to mumkin hai ke woh teacher ko dekhte hi uncomfortable mehsoos kare, chahe us waqt teacher ne kuch kaha bhi na ho.

Isi tarah agar kisi bachay ko baar baar daant ya criticism ka experience ho, to mumkin hai ke woh agle reaction ke darr se pehle hi emotionally alert ho jaye.

Main apne saath kuch aisa hi mehsoos karta hoon.

Abu ne abhi kuch kaha bhi nahi hota, lekin mere zehan mein pehle se yeh khayal hota hai:

"Bas meri koi baat na shuru ho jaye."

Yeh zaroori nahi ke mere har darr ka anjaam wahi ho jo main sochta hoon, lekin mere guzre hue experiences ne meri expectations par zaroor asar dala hai.

Aur shayad isi liye main unke paas baithne ke bajaye door rehna zyada comfortable samajhta hoon.

☕ 6 November 2026 — Aj Kiya hwa ? 

Ab aate hain aaj ke waqiay par.

Aaj, Friday, 6 November 2026, main yeh sab likh raha hoon.

Aur sach kahun to abhi bhi gusse mein hoon.

Aaj hua kuch yun...

Main bahar baitha hua tha.

Ghar mein sab log baithe thay aur khana bhi kha liya gaya tha.

Main bas wahan se uth kar jaane hi wala tha ke chai banne ki umeed nazar aayi.

Maine socha:

"Chalo, thori dair aur baith jata hoon. Kya pata chai ban jaye to pee kar hi chala jaun." 😄

Phir kuch dair baad chai choolhay par rakh di gayi.

Ab mujhe yakeen sa hone laga ke chai mil hi jayegi.

To main wahin baitha raha.

Lekin ek ajeeb baat thi.

Main chai ka intezar kar raha tha, magar saath hi dil mein darr bhi tha.

Kahin koi baat meri shuru na ho jaye.

Us waqt ghar mein mehmaan bhi aaye hue thay.

Kuch dair baad woh chale gaye aur ab sirf hum ghar walay reh gaye.

Chai bhi bas banne hi wali thi.

Aur phir...

Wahi hua jiska mujhe pehle se darr tha.

Abu ne poocha:

"Kal college jao gy?"

Maine kaha:

"Kal trip ja raha hai, to trip par jaunga."

Phir unhon ne poocha:

"Kal tuition gaye thay?"

Maine kaha:

"Nahi."

Aur bas...

Yahan se baat ek baar phir meri handwriting tak pohanch gayi.

Lekin is baat ko samajhne ke liye mujhe thora peeche jana parega.

✍️ Meri Handwriting — Ek Chhoti Kami Ya Bohat Bara Jurm? 

Baat darasal yeh hai ke meri handwriting utni achhi nahi thi.

Ab aisa bhi nahi ke bilkul hi kuch samajh na aaye.

Meri nazar mein meri handwriting normal thi.

Jaisi aam tor par bohat se boys ki average handwriting hoti hai, kuch waisi hi.

Lekin zahir hai, jo cheez mujhe theek lagti hai, zaroori nahi ke doosron ko bhi waisi hi lage.

Jab main 1st year mein tha to by chance college walon ne mere abu ko bataya tha ke meri writing ka masla hai.

Us waqt abu ne mujhe casually kaha tha:

"Apni likhai banao na."

Maine bhi us baat ko itna serious nahi liya.

Aur mere khayal mein us waqt abu ne bhi isay bohat serious issue nahi banaya tha.

Phir waqt guzarta gaya.

1st year ke exams qareeb aa gaye.

Taqreeban 15–20 din reh gaye thay.

Us waqt abu chuttiyon par ghar aaye hue thay aur shayad unki chuttiyan bhi khatam hone wali thi.

To woh mujhe ek aise teacher ke paas le gaye jo handwriting improve karwata tha.

Main usay aage chal kar "painter" bhi kahunga, kyunke hum usay isi tarah refer karte thay.

Abu ne usse baat ki.

Fees waghera tay ki.

Aur mujhe kaha ke roz wahan jaya karo.

Main wahan 2–3 din gaya bhi.

Lekin ek baat sach hai...

Mujhe shuru se hi handwriting improve karne mein itna interest nahi tha.

Aur doosri taraf mere exams bhi bohat qareeb aa chuke thay.

Mujhe lagta tha ke jab exams mein itna kam waqt reh gaya hai to roz 1–2 ghantay handwriting practice mein lagana mere liye mushkil hoga.

Phir abu wapas kaam par chale gaye.

Maine unhein phone kiya aur kaha ke exams qareeb hain, isliye abhi itna time nahi nikal sakta.

Maine kaha ke kuch months ke liye isay skip kar leta hoon.

Abu ne pehle to apne natural andaaz mein daanta.

Daantna shayad unki aadat ka hissa ban chuka hai. 😅

Phir ami ne unse baat ki.

Aur aakhirkaar woh maan gaye.

Bas phir maine handwriting wali classes chhor di.

Exams diye.

Aur exams ke baad?

Sach kahun to main is baat ko bhool gaya.

Ya shayad yeh kehna zyada sahi hoga ke mujhe interest hi nahi tha, isliye maine ignore kar diya.

Is mein meri apni zimmedari bhi thi.

Main chahta to handwriting ko khud bhi thora waqt de sakta tha.

Lekin maine nahi diya.

Uske baad abu bhi ghar aaye, magar unhon ne us waqt handwriting ke baare mein kuch nahi kaha.

Phir woh dobara kaam par chale gaye.

Aur zindagi isi tarah chalti rahi.

Lekin mujhe kya pata tha ke yeh chhota sa handwriting wala issue ek din meri zindagi ka itna bara discussion topic ban jayega.

📚 Result Ka Din — Biology Ne Dhoka De Diya! 😄 

Phir woh waqt aa gaya jab 1st year ka result aana tha.

Ittefaq se abu ki chuttiyon ke doraan hi mera result aane wala tha.

Aur ek interesting baat bataun?

Mujhe apne result ki itni tension nahi thi jitni abu ke reaction ki thi.

Mere zehan mein sirf ek khayal tha:

Agar by chance marks kam aa gaye...

Ya kisi subject mein supply aa gayi...

To phir abu ka lecture shayad poora saal khatam nahi hoga. 😑

Aur qismat ka khel dekho!

Hua bhi kuch aisa hi.

Mujhe Biology mein supply aa gayi.

Ab is mein interesting baat yeh thi ke Biology mera favourite subject tha.

Agar koi mujhse poochay ke tumhara favourite subject konsa hai, to main bina zyada soche kahunga:

Biology! 🧬

Lekin jis subject mein mujhe achhe marks ki umeed thi, usi mein supply aa gayi.

Yeh mere liye waqai surprising tha.

Magar kahani ka doosra hissa aur bhi interesting hai.

⚡ Physics — Jahan Fail Hone Ka Darr Tha, Wahin Pass Ho Gaya! 

1st year mein Physics mere liye sabse tough subjects mein se ek thi.

Aur 2nd year mein bhi Physics mujhe mushkil lagti hai.

Is subject mein mujhe supply aane ka andesha tha.

Lekin result dekha to Physics mein mere 85 mein se poore 28 marks thay.

Aur passing marks bhi 28 hi thay!

Matlab...

Main bilkul passing line par khara tha! 😂

Agar percentage calculate karun to yeh taqreeban 32.94% banti hai, yani 33% ke qareeb.

Aur mere result ke mutabiq main pass ho gaya tha.

Ab koi aur hota to shayad 28 marks dekh kar pareshan hota.

Lekin main?

Main to khush tha ke chalo yaar, jis subject mein fail hone ka sabse zyada darr tha, us mein bach gaya! 😄

📖 English — Jahan Apni Creativity Kaam Aa Gayi 

English ka result bhi mere liye interesting tha.

Sach yeh hai ke maine poore saal English mein bhi zyada interest nahi liya tha.

Exam mein ek 5 marks ka sawaal aisa aaya jiska jawab maine syllabus ke mutabiq yaad ki hui cheezon se nahi likha.

Balki apni creative thinking use karke likh diya.

Kuch doosre sawalon ke jawab bhi maine apni samajh aur marzi ke mutabiq likh diye thay.

Aur jab result aaya to...

English mein 100 mein se 69 marks! 😄

Mere hisaab se yeh bohat achhe marks thay.

Kyunke jitni meri preparation thi, uske muqable mein result meri expectation se kaafi behtar tha.

Isi tarah doosre subjects mein bhi mere hisaab se theek marks aaye.
Jaisy islamiyaat ma 45 out of 50 aur Tarjama tul Quran ma 47 out of 50 .
Lekin ek ajeeb ittefaq tha.

Jis subject mein fail hone ki umeed thi, us mein pass ho gaya. Aur jis mein achhe marks ki umeed thi, usi mein supply aa gayi.

Zindagi bhi kabhi kabhi ajeeb surprises deti hai!

Lekin...

Meri khushi ke saath ek doosri kahani bhi shuru hone wali thi.

😔 Ek Supply Aur Baar Baar Wahi Taana 

Result aane ke baad abu ne Biology ki supply ko lekar mujhe sirf ek baar daant kar baat khatam nahi ki.

Balki meri observation ke mutabiq jab bhi kisi baat par gussa aata, result ka topic dobara saamne aa jata.

Aur phir wahi baat:

"Isko parhai mein interest hi nahi hai."

Yeh baat mujhe bohat buri lagti thi.

Kyunke mere nazdeek kisi ek subject mein supply aane ka matlab yeh nahi ke insaan ko parhai mein bilkul interest hi nahi.

Haan, main yeh maanta hoon ke meri preparation har subject mein achhi nahi thi.

Main kuch subjects ko utna waqt nahi de saka jitna dena chahiye tha.

Lekin mere liye yeh bhi zaroori tha ke meri kamiyon ko ek specific problem ke taur par dekha jaye, meri poori personality ke faislay ke taur par nahi.

Ek exam mein fail hona aur zindagi mein fail hona do bilkul alag cheezein hain.

Aur shayad hamare muashray mein hum aksar in dono cheezon ko mila dete hain.

🧠 Labels Ka Asar 

Psychology mein ek important baat samajhne wali hai.

Jab kisi insan ko baar baar kisi negative label se describe kiya jata hai, jaise ke woh lazy hai, careless hai ya usay kisi cheez mein interest hi nahi, to yeh labels uski self-image par asar daal sakte hain.

Har insan par iska asar ek jaisa nahi hota.

Kuch log criticism ko motivation bana lete hain.

Lekin kuch log isse emotionally exhausted, defensive ya discouraged mehsoos karne lagte hain.

Mere nazdeek yahan ek important difference hai.

"Tumhari Biology ki preparation kamzor thi" ek specific problem ki taraf ishara karta hai.

Lekin "Tumhein parhai mein interest hi nahi" ek general judgement ban sakta hai.

Pehli baat sudhar ka raasta dikha sakti hai.

Doosri baat kabhi kabhi insan ko yeh mehsoos karwa sakti hai ke uski baqi mehnat ki koi value nahi.

🏫 College Progress Aur Handwriting Ka Dobara Zinda Ho Jana 

Result ke baad abu meri progress lene college chale gaye.

Wahan teachers se meri performance ke baare mein baat hui.

Aur unhon ne meri handwriting ka issue bhi discuss kiya.

Unke mutabiq meri writing achhi nahi thi.

Yahan tak kaha gaya ke meri supply mein handwriting ka bhi role ho sakta hai.

Aur agar main apni handwriting improve kar loon to 2nd year mein achhe marks aa sakte hain.

Aur teachers mery abu ko larkiyon ki misaal dy jar bata rhy thy ky unky marks ziady unki beautiful handwriting ki waja sy extra marks milti han .

Isi tarah yeh kehna ke larkiyon ke marks sirf isliye zyada aate hain kyunke unki writing achhi hoti hai, mere nazdeek ek oversimplification hai.

Achhe marks ke liye sirf handwriting nahi, balki understanding aur preparation bhi important hain.

Lekin us waqt jo baat sabse zyada highlight hui, woh meri handwriting thi.

Aur phir ghar wapas aate hue abu ne mujhe lecture dena shuru kar diya.

Woh purani baat dobara saamne aa gayi.

Ke maine tumhein handwriting improve karne ko kaha tha.

Do teen dafa kaha tha.

Ek baar teacher ke paas bitha kar bhi aaya tha.

Lekin tumne baat nahi maani.

Phir abu meri us waqt ki baat ki mimicry karne lage.

Jab maine exams se pehle kaha tha ke:

"Exams aa rahe hain, isliye time nahi milta."

Ab yahan mujhe sabse zyada bura laga.
Haan, ho sakta hai meri explanation poori tarah justified na ho.

Ho sakta hai mujhe handwriting ke liye waqt nikalna chahiye tha.

Lekin meri nazar mein kisi ki baat se disagree karna aur uski mimicry karke usay sharminda mehsoos karwana alag cheezein hain.

🖊️ Painter Ki Dukaan Aur Meri Handwriting Ka Faisla 

Usi din abu mujhe dobara handwriting wale teacher ke paas le gaye.

Unhon ne usse kaha ke meri writing dekho aur batao kaisi hai.

Ab mere zehan mein ek ajeeb si baat aayi.

Main soch raha tha ke agar hum kisi insan ke paas koi skill seekhne gaye hain to zahir hai ke woh hamari kami ki taraf ishara karega.

Agar woh keh de ke tumhari writing bilkul perfect hai to phir hum usse seekhne kyun aaye hain?

Lekin jo bhi tha, us teacher ne bhi meri writing ko kamzor bataya.

Aur phir abu ne is baat ko bhi note kar liya.

Ghar wapas aaye to meri handwriting ka discussion phir shuru ho gaya.

Abu ghar walon ko batane lage ke meri writing achhi nahi.

College teachers ne yeh kaha.

Handwriting teacher ne woh kaha.

Aur is tarah ek hi baat baar baar discuss hone lagi.

Abu ke mutabiq handwriting teacher ne yahan tak kaha tha ke:

"Itni ghatiya writing to pehli ya doosri class ke bachon ki hoti hai."
Mujhe mehsoos hone laga tha jaise meri ek kami ko ghar mein baar baar mere khilaaf evidence ke taur par pesh kiya ja raha hai.

💔 Jab Correction, Humiliation Jaisi Mehsoos Hone Lage 

Mere nazdeek kisi insan ko improve karne ke do tareeqay ho sakte hain.

Ek yeh ke uski kami identify ki jaye, usay practical tareeqa bataya jaye aur phir uski progress dekhi jaye.

Doosra yeh ke uski kami ko baar baar doosron ke saamne discuss kiya jaye.

Ho sakta hai dono ka maqsad improvement ho.

Lekin dono ka emotional effect ek jaisa nahi hota.

Kisi ki galti sudharna zaroori ho sakta hai, lekin uski izzat bachate hue bhi galti sudhari ja sakti hai.

Aur mere khayal mein hamare muashray ko is difference par bohat sochne ki zaroorat hai.

🚶‍♂️ 1.5 Kilometer Ka Safar Aur Roz Ki Wahi Kahani 

Agla din aaya.

Abu ne mujhe kaha ke handwriting teacher ke paas jaane ka waqt ho gaya hai.

Aur saath hi apne andaaz mein kehne lage ke paidal jao, tangon mein zang lag gaya hai, woh bhi theek karna hai.

Us painter ki dukaan hamare ghar se taqreeban 1.5 kilometer door thi.

Main us din paidal gaya.

Aur paidal hi wapas aaya.

Agle din abu ne mujhe fees bhi de di.

Aur phir kaha ke jao.

Main dobara paidal gaya.

Isi tarah taqreeban 3–4 din guzre.

Main classes attend karta raha.

Lekin sach kahun to andar se mera is kaam mein interest ab bhi zyada nahi tha.

Main samajhta hoon ke handwriting improve karna mere liye faidemand ho sakta tha.

Lekin is poore experience ke saath itna pressure aur daant associate ho chuki thi ke mere liye yeh sirf ek skill seekhne ka process nahi raha tha.

Ab yeh ek aisa kaam bataya giya joky mujhy zaroor karna ha.

🧠 Motivation Aur Control Ka Connection 

Psychology mein motivation ko samajhne ke liye Self-Determination Theory ek useful framework hai.

Is theory ke mutabiq insan ki motivation par autonomy, competence aur relatedness ka asar hota hai.

Yani insan ko kuch had tak apne faislon par control mehsoos ho, usay apni improvement nazar aaye aur uske relationships supportive hon.

Jab kisi kaam ke saath sirf pressure, criticism ya punishment associate ho jaye to mumkin hai ke insan us kaam mein interest kho de.

Yeh har case mein nahi hota.

Lekin mere experience mein mujhe kuch aisa hi mehsoos hua.

Shayad agar handwriting improve karne ko ek personal challenge banaya jata, meri chhoti improvements ko appreciate kiya jata to mera reaction different hota.
Aur Seedhi baat bataon tu handwriting koi itna bara impact ni daalti agar daalti tu aj doctor koi na ban pata. Kiyonky jitni doctors ki handwriting kharab hoti ha utni shayad 1 class ky student ki bhi na ho. 

Motivation na ho tab bhi discipline zaroori hota hai, lekin discipline aur constant humiliation ek cheez nahi hain.

🕊️ Ek Din Ki Azaadi — Aur Phir Wahi Udaasi 

Phir ek din achanak ami aur abu ko mere mamo ke ghar jana para.

Unhein wahan raat bhi rehna pari.

Main handwriting teacher ke paas shaam ko jata tha.

Lekin us din main nahi gaya.

Aur yakeen karo...

Us din mujhe ajeeb sa sukoon aur azaadi mehsoos ho rahi thi.

Aisa lag raha tha jaise kuch waqt ke liye mere upar se pressure hat gaya ho.

Main araam se tha.

Kisi lecture ka darr nahi.

Kisi baat ke shuru hone ka andesha nahi.

Kisi galti ko lekar discussion hone ki tension nahi.

Bas ek ajeeb sa sukoon tha.

Phir agle din jab abu aur ami wapas aaye...

Mera dil dobara udaas ho gaya.

Jo khushi mehsoos ho rahi thi, woh achanak sadness mein badal gayi.

Kyunke mujhe laga ke meri woh temporary azaadi khatam ho gayi.

Ab main yahan ek baat sochta hoon.

Aakhir aisa kyun hota hai ke kabhi kabhi apne hi ghar ke logon ki gair-maujoodgi mein insaan zyada comfortable mehsoos karta hai?

Kya iska matlab yeh hai ke woh apne parents se mohabbat nahi karta?

Zaroori nahi.

Mere nazdeek mohabbat aur emotional comfort alag alag experiences ho sakte hain.

Insaan kisi se mohabbat karte hue bhi uske reactions se pareshan ho sakta hai.

Kisi ki respect karte hue bhi uske saamne uncomfortable mehsoos kar sakta hai.

Aur kisi apne ke saath relationship behtar banana chahte hue bhi filhaal usse distance rakhna pasand kar sakta hai.
